// 智能体对象包含以下字段 (Agent Schema)
const agent = {
  id: 'agent_001',              // 唯一ID
  name: '英语单词助手',         // 名称
  icon: '📚',                  // 图标/Emoji
  description: '解释单词、例句', // 描述
  systemPrompt: '你是英语助手',// 系统提示词(人设)
  userId: 0,                    // 创建者ID (0=官方)
  isPublic: true,               // 是否公开分享
  ragEnabled: false,            // 是否启用RAG知识库
  knowledgeBaseId: null,        // 关联知识库ID (可选)
  tools: []                     // 启用的函数调用列表 (如web_search/mindmap)
}

<template>
  <view class="home">
    <scroll-view scroll-y>
      <view class="section">
        <text class="title">官方智能体</text>
        <view class="grid">
          <view v-for="a in official" :key="a.id" class="card" @click="openAgent(a)">
            <text class="icon">{{ a.icon }}</text>
            <text class="name">{{ a.name }}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
      </view>
      <view class="section" v-if="custom.length">
        <text class="title">我的智能体</text>
        <view class="grid">
          <view v-for="a in custom" :key="a.id" class="card" @click="openAgent(a)">
            <text class="icon">{{ a.icon }}</text>
            <text class="name">{{ a.name }}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
      </view>
      <button class="create-btn" @click="createAgent">+ 创建智能体</button>
    </scroll-view>
  </view>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue'
const official = ref([])
const custom = ref([])

onMounted(async () => {
  const res = await uni.request({ url: '/api/agents' })
  official.value = res.data.filter(a => a.userId === 0)
  custom.value = res.data.filter(a => a.userId !== 0)
})

function openAgent(agent) {
  uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/chat/detail?id=' + agent.id })
}
function createAgent() {
  uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/agent/create' })
}
</script>

<template>
  <view class="chat">
    <scroll-view scroll-y class="messages" :scroll-into-view="scrollTo">
      <view v-for="msg in messages" :key="msg.id" :class="['msg', msg.role]">
        <text>{{ msg.content }}</text>
      </view>
      <view :id="scrollTo"></view>
    </scroll-view>
    <view class="input-bar">
      <input v-model="input" placeholder="输入消息..." @confirm="send" />
      <button size="mini" @click="send">发送</button>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, onLoad } from '@dcloudio/uni-app'

const messages = ref([])
const input = ref('')
const agentId = ref('')
const agent = ref(null)

onLoad(async (options) => {
  agentId.value = options.id
  const res = await uni.request({ url: '/api/agents/' + agentId.value })
  agent.value = res.data
  messages.value = res.data.history || []
})

async function send() {
  messages.value.push({ id: Date.now(), role: 'user', content: input.value })
  const aiMsg = { id: Date.now()+1, role: 'assistant', content: '' }
  messages.value.push(aiMsg)
  await streamChat(input.value, aiMsg)
  input.value = ''
}
</script>

<template>
  <view class="create-page">
    <view class="form">
      <view class="field">
        <text class="label">名称</text>
        <input v-model="form.name" placeholder="智能体名称" />
      </view>
      <view class="field">
        <text class="label">图标</text>
        <input v-model="form.icon" placeholder="Emoji图标" />
      </view>
      <view class="field">
        <text class="label">系统提示词(人设)</text>
        <textarea v-model="form.systemPrompt" placeholder="你是一个英语老师..." />
      </view>
      <view class="toggle">
        <text>启用RAG知识库</text>
        <switch :checked="form.ragEnabled" />
      </view>
      <view class="field" v-if="form.ragEnabled">
        <text class="label">关联知识库</text>
        <picker :range="kbList" @change="form.knowledgeBaseId = $event.detail.value">
          <text>{{ selectedKB }}</text>
        </picker>
      </view>
      <view class="field">
        <text class="label">函数调用</text>
        <checkbox-group @change="form.tools = $event.detail.value">
          <label v-for="t in tools" :key="t.id">
            <checkbox :value="t.id" />{{ t.name }}
          </label>
        </checkbox-group>
      </view>
      <button @click="save">保存智能体</button>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
const form = ref({ name: '', icon: '🤖', systemPrompt: '', ragEnabled: false, knowledgeBaseId: null, tools: [] })
const kbList = ref([])
const selectedKB = computed(() => {
  const kb = kbList.value.find(k => k.id === form.value.knowledgeBaseId)
  return kb ? kb.name : '请选择'
})
async function save() {
  await uni.request({ url: '/api/agents', method: 'POST', data: form.value })
  uni.showToast({ title: '创建成功' })
  uni.navigateBack()
}
</script>

<template>
  <view class="kb-page">
    <button @click="uploadDoc">上传文档</button>
    <view v-for="doc in documents" :key="doc.id" class="doc-item">
      <text>{{ doc.name }}</text>
      <text>{{ doc.chunkCount }} 片段</text>
      <text>{{ doc.status }}</text>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
const documents = ref([])

async function uploadDoc() {
  const res = await uni.chooseFile({ count: 1, type: 'all' })
  const file = res.tempFiles[0]
  uni.showLoading({ title: '处理中...' })
  const text = await readFile(file.path)
  const chunks = text.split(/\n\n+/).filter(p => p.length > 50)
  for (const chunk of chunks) {
    await addChunk(chunk)
  }
  uni.hideLoading()
  uni.showToast({ title: '处理完成' })
  loadDocuments()
}

async function readFile(path) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const fs = uni.getFileSystemManager()
    fs.readFile({ filePath: path, encoding: 'utf8', success: (r) => resolve(r.data) })
  })
}
</script>

<template>
  <view class="pay-page">
    <text>订单金额: ￥{{ amount }}</text>
    <button @click="pay">立即支付</button>
  </view>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
const amount = ref(99)
async function pay() {
  const { payParams } = await uni.request({
    url: '/api/payment/create',
    method: 'POST',
    data: { amount: amount.value, description: 'VIP会员' }
  })
  uni.requestPayment({
    ...payParams,
    success: () => uni.showToast({ title: '支付成功' }),
    fail: () => uni.showToast({ title: '支付取消', icon: 'none' })
  })
}
</script>
